title: Alien Stairway to the Moon
description: A surreal steampunk scene featuring a skeletal alien with a multi-eyed head sitting inside a colorful mechanical pod atop tall, winding green stairs. The structure stands on a cobblestone street between a European-style village on the left and sand dunes on the right, with a large green cratered moon, aurora borealis, and a sunset behind a domed building in the background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a skeletal alien with a round head full of black circular eyes, wearing a brown jacket, sitting in an orange and green mechanical pod. The pod rests on impossibly tall, winding green spiral stairs with bone motifs that stand on a cobblestone street. Left side shows a quaint European town with flower pots and striped awnings, right side has desert sand dunes. In the sky a large glowing green cratered moon, green aurora, and a sunset behind a domed cathedral.
